schema_change.additive_extension_tables: run_cancellations(stream_id PK, generation, state, at), external_delegations(delegation_id PK, scope_id, stream_id, generation, state, external_ref, recorded_at) in sqlite/repository.py EXTENSION_DDL
schema_change.rationale: durable cancel-reconcile state and delegation identity are ledger concerns; additive tables follow the coord_tasks/event_blobs precedent
schema_change.new_repo_apis: claim_job (bind a claim to one job id), record_usage (bill observed usage on unknown outcomes), fail_job (fence-checked failed settle); all mirror submit_result's fence semantics

architecture.attempt_lifecycle: run_work enqueues a durable outbox job before invoking the worker, claims it by job id, settles via fence-checked submit_result/fail_job, or marks unknown on timeout — a crash leaves evidence, never a guess
architecture.no_blind_retry: a task whose latest job is unknown refuses run_work until reconcile_attempt records an explicit disposition
architecture.cancel_semantics: cancel_run durably blocks new dispatch (run_cancellations), cancels pending jobs, marks leased jobs unknown, and reports observed partial results
architecture.source_apply: apply_to_target requires a separate source_apply grant, checks every preimage before writing, journals preimage+postimage per file, and reports partial honestly; rollback restores only files still matching the journaled postimage
architecture.external_worker: peer declarations are untrusted metadata; usable capability is declared∩granted; peer completed maps to unverified; cancel is a request not a stop; late artifacts are billed+audited but fenced

review_notes: post-image review found and fixed: ExpectedChain.advance partially mutated state before an out-of-grant ACL_DENIED (now validates all applied entries first); map_workspace_path allowed /remote/ws2 to match the /remote/ws prefix (now boundary-checked); submit recorded 'submitted' before the transport call and a non-timeout error left a false record (now rejected vs unknown); run_test_recipe propagated ET.ParseError on corrupt JUnit XML (now yields no results, verdict via exit code)
pytest exit-code semantics: 5 (no tests collected) and 2-4 (runner error) are distinct verdicts — empty collection is not_run, runner error is unverifiable
check_artifact_uri does not resolve DNS — a hostname allowlist cannot prevent rebinding to private addresses; literal-IP and scheme checks are enforced
apply journal_id is deterministic over grant subject + patch set; a second identical apply reuses the journal path
